name: Ted and Alice
summary:
Ted is an alien come to earth to find love and where better to begin his search than the Lake District, an area rich in romantic heritage and full of tranquil lakes ideal to hide a spaceship in.

Ted is an outcast on his own planet, where the inhabitants have evolved so far that they are hermaphrodites. He is one of the rare single sex aliens condemned to a life in search of contact.

Alice works in the local tourist office with her friend Jo. She is the long suffering girlfriend of Barry, the village Bobby, who alternates between dumping his washing on Alices doorstep with disappearing on illicit jaunts with his friends.

Alice dreams of a real romance akin to Darcy and Elisabeth and it seems her life is set to change when Ted appears on her doorstep.

Worlds collide when Ted and Alice meet, however all is not as it seems in the picturesque lakeside village where sinister activities threaten to tear them apart.

name: The Force
summary: With unprecedented and unvarnished access to Hampshire Constabulary, a typical large provincial police force in the grip of profound change, this three-part series follows the investigation of major crimes. A murder investigation starts with a body burnt beyond recognition but with no clues to the identity of killer or victim. An arson attack consumes a Portsmouth block of flats and destroys evidence of who set the fire. And a rape case is her word against his, with not much evidence to go on: all too often this has meant that the male party gets off, but can a new pilot scheme improve the conviction rate? These crimes aren't unique to Hampshire; they're replicated in every incident room in the country. As Hampshire police struggle to follow the evidence - or lack of it.

name: Bees, Butterflies and Blooms
summary: Sarah Raven is on a mission to halt the decline in honey bees and insect pollinators with insect friendly flower power in this three part series.

name: Rosemary Shrager's School for Cooks
summary: Each week, 10 amateur chefs are brought into the renowned cuisine master, Rosemary Shrager's cookery school. Throughout the week, the students are divided in to two teams, and are given three recipes to make throughout the day, a starter, main and dessert courses. Every day (until Thursday), two students are eliminated, and one more is eliminated on Thursday. Therefore, three students go in to the final on Friday, the winner then gets a chance to work in a Michelin-starred restaurant.

name: The Apprentice
summary: The Apprentice is an Irish reality television series, in which a group of 14 aspiring businessmen and women compete for the chance to win a job as "apprentice" to businessman Bill Cullen. Each week the candidates take part in a task set by Bill. Each team will have a Project Manager who managers that group for that task. The team that performs the best will win a reward and avoid the boardroom. The losing team will be summoned to the boardroom where their project manager will be forced to pick two people in their team tol join them in the boardroom where one of them will be fired.

name: Podge and Rodge: A Scare at Bedtime
summary: Two potty-mouthed puppets, Podge and Rodge. tell scary stories that include bad language and sexual innuendo.

name: Triangle
summary: Triangle was a television soap opera in the early 1980s, set aboard a North Sea ferry which sailed a triangular route between Felixstowe, Rotterdam and Gothenburg.

name: 20 Things to Do Before You're 30
summary: A group of friends who are approaching 30 make a list of unusual tasks to perform before they reach that age.

name: 2DTV
summary: 2DTV is a short animated satirical show that keeps up to date with the latest stories. Using a special kind of animation, it is able to make characters and places quite easily and finished on the date in which it's supposed to be aired.

name: Beauty and the Beast: The Ugly Face of Prejudice
summary: We live in a society obsessed with physical perfection, surrounded by images of unattainable beauty. Nine out of ten women in Britain are unhappy with their appearance, over half would resort to surgery to change it, and nearly three quarters of Brits think that being better looking would make them more successful. Meanwhile, half a million people in Britain have a serious facial disfigurement, and must counter the negative connotations many of us apply to such differences on a daily basis. This series investigates the extremes of dissatisfaction and discrimination by bringing together two people defined by the way they look, but who approach the beauty debate from very different sides. Can someone who lives with a facial disfigurement convince a self-confessed beauty addict that true beauty comes from within?

name: Gold Digger
summary: Gold Digger tells the story of wealthy 60 year old Julia as she falls in love with Benjamin, a man 25 years her junior. As this six part series progresses the impact their unconventional relationship has on her family is explored and the secrets of their past are revealed. Has Julia finally found the happiness she's always deserved? Or is Benjamin really the gold digger they think he is?

name: Dark Mon£y
summary: Dark Mon£y sees an ordinary London family decide to accept a substantial pay-off from a renowned filmmaker to keep silent about the abuse of their youngest son. Although guilt-ridden, they believe the money will enable the family to heal and move on, to start a new life and erase the memories of the past. But damage runs deep, and the price of taking the money may be very high.

name: The Capture
summary: While disentangling misinformation from truth in an era of deepfakes, alternative facts and ubiquitous surveillance, investigations of damning video evidence calls into question whether seeing is deceiving.

name: Fastest Car
summary: The drivers of exotic supercars put their street cred on the line against deceptively fast sleeper cars built and modified by true gearheads.

name: Beecham House
summary:
The story begins as handsome and soulful former soldier, John Beecham, has acquired the house to start a new life for his family and a business as a trader. Wealthy and distinguished, John has witnessed profiteering and exploitation during his time with the controlling East India Company and appears haunted by his past. Determined to escape that life, he sets his sights on becoming an honorable member of the region's trading community.

But in the glorious setting of Beecham House, John's life remains shrouded in mystery. His arrival provokes speculation and gossip amongst the servants and despite filling his residence with relatives and friends, Beecham's house still has dark corners that crackle with conspiracy, disharmony and sinister intent. The story also unfolds at a time when the 1,000-year-old Mughal rule is over and the British vie with the Maharajas to claim India as their own.

name: Flack
summary: Flack is set in the fast-paced and cut-throat world of celebrity PR. Equal parts hilarity and heart, it reflects the brutal reality and complexities of modern life where problems can go viral in an instant. It follows Robyn, an American PR executive living in London who must figure out how to make the best of bad situations and somehow manage to get out unscathed.

name: Slow Dance
summary: A man who constantly applies the brake in his life, a woman who could do with a brake in her life. They have their careers but they are both failures in love. Afraid to face each other directly, instead of focusing on feelings, they choose to focus on their positions, meeting each other, falling in love!? They are already adults but still have some way to go when it comes to puttingtheir foot on the ground. This summer, a feel-good love story...

name: Kan iedereen nog volgen?
summary: What does our future look like? Lieven Scheire creates in Can Anyone Still Follow? light in the darkness. Floating tunnels, robots that do somersaults, a mattress against adultery, the erasing of traumas and tattoos, trash cans that arrange your groceries or fingernails with which you can pay. Together with his panel, Lieven outlines what our lives will look like in 2019, in 2030 or in 2050.

name: The Many Faces of Ito
summary: A once successful screenwriter in her 30s finds inspiration when she decides to interview four women about a man named Ito that they all seem to have feelings for.

name: So You Think You Can Dance
summary: Cat Deeley presents the search for Britain's Favourite Dancer. Nigel Lythgoe and Arlene Phillips are on the judging panel as contestants are challenged to different styles of dance.

name: Electric Dreams
summary: A family and their home are stripped of all their modern technology to live a life of decades past.

name: The Wrong Door
summary: Sketch show set in a parallel universe, in which a mix of celebrity cameos, unimaginable locations and impossible visual effects heralds a brave new world of comic possibility.

name: Rides
summary: A drama series about an all-woman minicab firm. Patrice Jenner, a former Royal Corps of Transport warrant officer starts up an all-women taxi firm.

name: Jeremy Clarkson Meets the Neighbours
summary: Jeremy Clarkson drives a 1960s Jaguar E-Type around six European countries to discover just how different their lifestyles are to those in Britain, and whether the reality matches the stereotypical perception of each country.

name: Catastrophe
summary: This spectacular five-part series, investigates the history of natural disasters, from the planet's beginnings to the present, putting a new perspective on our existence – that we are the product of catastrophe. Using the latest CGI effects and featuring scientific experts, the series reveals how the evolution of life on Earth has been shaped by lethal catastrophes that have caused mass extinctions, almost to the point of wiping out life altogether.

name: Crash
summary: Drama about a group of young doctors who are working in their first jobs at a Cardiff hospital.

name: The Bachelor
summary: One of the country's most eligible bachelors, is on a quest for the woman of his dreams. Expect flirting, friction and fun as, in a romantic reality series filmed in some of the most glamorous locations in the world, 25 girls share a villa and compete for his affections.

name: Full House
summary: Full House tells the story of two young couples, the Hatfields and the McCoys. Paul Hatfield and his wife Marsha, have been married for three years, and have been living with Paul's mother, until they finally find their ideal home. However, they are unable to meet the mortgage repayments, so they invite Murray McCoy and his girlfriend Diana, who are also in the same situation, to join them and move in with them, contributing to the payment of the house.

name: The Fosters
summary: The first sitcom written both for and starring black actors, The Fosters showcased the early work of Lenny Henry as the budding artist son of easygoing family man Samuel Foster. The series follows the day-to-day trials of Samuel and his lively wife Pearl (both immigrants from Guyana) and their three children on a South London housing estate.

name: Daredevils
summary: A series of visually stunning films following some of the world's most extreme individuals, who risk their lives pushing themselves to the physical and mental limits of human capability.

name: MAKE! Craft Britain
summary: A joyful celebration of all things handmade, following ordinary people having a go at new skills taught by inspirational teachers.

name: White Boyz in the Hood
summary: White Boyz in the Hood is based on the idea of the interrelationship between black and white culture in modern-day United States. Many famous comedians have based their comedy routines on the different cultures of a nation. The comedians are white and play towards a mostly black audience. Today in America the urban comedy scene is thriving and white comedians are honing their skills at these types of venues. The creators of this show wanted to break down walls that exist between white and black America. In doing so this show accomplishes a great deal of laughter to subjects such as employment, drug abuse and many more issues that affect Americans.

name: Your Husband is Cheating on Us
summary: Your Husband is Cheating on Us shines a light on this powerful world revealing the show behind the show. Over the course of the series, producer and director JD Lawrence mounts his new production of the stage play Your Husband Is Cheating On Us, implementing unorthodox creative methods with his cast. His strategies include moving everyone into a house together and injecting real-life experiences from their lives into the script. Additionally, the behind-the-scenes drama between the cast members takes matters to another level that will either make or break the show.

name: Falco
summary: Set in Mexico City in 1994, the series follows Alejandro Falco, a policeman with a promising future and a young family. However, his world is shattered when he is shot by a mysterious attacker in the line of duty.

name: The Voice of Italy
summary: The Voice of Italy is a reality singing competition and Italian version of the international syndication "The Voice" based on the reality singing competition launched in the Netherlands.

name: Trails to Tsukiji
summary: Trails to Tsukiji is a show that focuses on Japanese food available at Tokyo's iconic Tsukiji Market where every kind of fresh food is gathered from around the country.

name: Are You the One? Sverige
summary: Why leave love for fate? I Are you the one - Sweden has 20 glow singles undergoing thorough tests and interviews before arriving at a luxury home in Thailand. In the group there is one person who is each participant's "perfect match" - but nobody knows who it is. By hanging out in the house, competing and going on a date, the participants come week by week trying to figure out which ones are perfect for each other - and maybe be dear to the coup. The question is whether they fall for the right person? If all participants succeed in their matches, they share the winning sum: one million kronor.

name: Direct Talk
summary: Direct and in-depth. Interviews exploring the minds and motivations of the leaders, visionaries, artists and entrepreneurs who are changing our world.

previousepisode.name: Nurturing Well-Being for Everyone: Sanada Hiromi / President, Ishikawa Prefectural Nursing University / Professor Emerita, The University of Tokyo

name: First Love Story
summary:
Do you remember when we met for the first time?

Hyun Jin - a girl who finally meets her coveted guy.
Hee Jin - a girl that is still in love.
Ha Seul - a girl who is a childhood friend.

name: Honey and Clover
summary: The series shows how five ardent youths from University of the Arts face love, friendship, and the future.

name: The Best Moment to Quit Your Job
summary: The Best Moment to Quit Your Job follows five millennial women on their quest to find themselves in the early days of their professions. Series lead actress, 26-year-old Yun Ji is a rookie designer working at a wet wipes factory who shares the frustrating reality of her work life with her friends.

name: Siege in Fog
summary: An arrogant third master of a powerful family falls in love at first sight with a pretty young maiden and uses every means possible to force her hand in marriage, despite her harboring a crush on another man. In the beginning of a coerced marriage, she resents him and rejects all his advances and gestures of love, but their love story slowly develops after going through obstacles in times of war andchaos. However, things get complicated when her old flame returns and becomes her husband's assistant.

name: Flower Ever After
summary: Flowever Ever After is a web drama about the frank and realistic troubles such as the love and marriage of a couple in their mid-twenties who are living together for 7 years, and a marriageable couple in their early 30s.

name: The Ken Dodd Laughter Show
summary: Bearing his trademark tickling stick and tattifilarious jokes, The Ken Dodd Laughter Show stars Knotty Ash's most famous son in a classic mix of madcap sketches, musical numbers and quick-fire stand-up.

name: Screen Two
summary: Screen Two is a anthology series of one-off drama's made especially for television.

name: Show Me the Movie!
summary:
Show Me the Movie! features two competing teams captained by acclaimed actor Jane Harber and comedy star Joel Creasey.

Each week, host Rove McManus, Jane and Joel will be joined by a stellar cast of different actors, comedians and visiting international stars, who will do battle in a series of funny, irreverent and always entertaining rounds.

name: Everlasting Immortal Firmament
summary:
Heavenly Dao is eternal, however life is limited, making heaven and earth pieces of a chessboard.
Gu Hai from the 21st century was taken onto another world. Gu Hai became a formidable opponent in the area of trade. In the times of war, he comes up with strategies for the Chen Empire against the Song Empire. A fairy from heaven became interested in him and gave him a mission to complete on his journey. However this may bring turmoil and chaos upon the world.

name: Soul Land
summary: Тан Сан провел свою жизнь во Внешней секте Тан, посвятив себя созданию и освоению скрытого оружия. Как только он украл тайные знания Внутренней Секты, чтобы достичь вершины своего искусства, его единственным выходом была смерть. Но после того, как он сбросился со смертоносного Пика Ада, он переродился в другом мире, мире Доуло Далу, мире, где у каждого человека есть собственный дух, и те, у кого сильный дух, могут практиковать свою духовную силу, чтобы подняться и стать Духом. Мастера. @@Дух, который пробуждается в Тан Сане, — это Голубая Серебряная Трава, бесполезный дух. Сможет ли он преодолеть трудности, чтобы достичь высоких званий духовных мастеров и принести славу секты Тан в этот новый мир?

name: Rising
summary: A documentary series that profiles rising stars in various fields-inspiring people who are challenging conventional wisdom and leading the pack.

previousepisode.name: Connecting Textile Production Areas and Designers: Fashion Curator - Miyaura Shinya

name: Painting the Holy Land with Lachlan Goudie
summary: In a two-part special for Holy Week, artist Lachlan Goudie goes on a trip of a lifetime to the Holy Land, sketching and painting the people and landscapes he sees there.

name: Isekai Izakaya ~Koto Aitheria no Izakaya Nobu~
summary:
On a deserted street somewhere in Kyoto resides a Japanese style pub called "Izakaya Nobu." But this hole in the wall holds a secret: its entrance is mysteriously linked to another world!
Chief Nobuyuki Yazawa and his server, Shinobu Senke, have decided to open up business in this distant and strange land, an ancient city known as "Aitheria."
Palace guards, craftsmen, merchants, noblemen… Nobu's doors are open for business, welcoming one and all with a cold beer and a warm meal!

name: The Boat Race
summary: Coverage from the River Thames as rowing crews from Oxford and Cambridge Universities race each other over four and a quarter miles from Putney to Mortlake.

name: Yo-Kai Watch Shadowside
summary: Keita grew up, and became unable to see Yo-Kai anymore. His duty was completed, and the watch was sealed away. 30 years later, Yo-Kai begin to act up again, and his daughter Natsume is chosen as one of the few successors to the Yo-Kai Watch. Natsume's younger brother, Keisuke, is a fifth grader who does not believe in ghosts, UFOs, or even Yo-Kai. Lately, he has noticed that Natsume has been coming home late, and one day decides to tail her. When he discovers that Natsume goes to a Yo-Kai detective agency, Natsume is forced to involve Keisuke in her activities.

name: The Big Ward
summary: Follow the emotional and inspiring journeys of six morbidly obese Kiwis on the road to healthier lives.

name: Indian Summer School
summary: Five British boys who have failed their core GCSEs are given a second chance at a school like no other. Inspired by studies which suggest white working class boys do better academically in ethnically mixed classrooms, the boys take part in a study programme at the world famous Doon School in India. One of the best schools in the world, with an exam pass rate of 100%, British head teacher Matthew Raggett believes he can transform the boys' prospects in just six months, preparing them to re-sit their exams. The boys will have to shake off their old habits if they wish to survive the rigorous standards at Doon. Will they knuckle down?

name: НЕлюбовь
summary:
Tamara always considered her eldest daughter Dinka the main mistake in her life, because Dinka was born as a result of rape. However, the attitude towards the unloved daughter is changing for the better, when Peter, a widower with his son Sasha, appears in Tamara's life. But Peter dies in a fire. According to one version, the cause of the fire at home was Dina playing with matches. Tamara's hatred for her daughter flares up again.

Years pass by. Tamara fanatically loves her younger daughter Lucy, born of Peter, and adores her stepson, Sasha, who becomes more and more like his father. Having learned that Romantic relations are established between him and Dina, Tamara does her best to separate them ...

name: Mega Man: Fully Charged
summary: Mega Man: Fully Charged features exciting new technologies and robots, as well as the introduction of Mega Man's alter-ego, Aki Light. Aki is a normal, upbeat, schoolboy robot who has nano-core technology that allows him to transform into the mega powered superhero Mega Man! With his Mega Buster arm cannon and iconic helmet, Mega Man battles the wickedest villains Silicon City has to offer. Beloved characters, such as Mega Man's robotic dog, Rush, will return--while new characters, like Mega Mini™ and Suna Light, will make their debut!

name: Первый раз прощается
summary: The owner of a factory, Tatiana decides that on the anniversary of their marriage with Gleb, she will give him the reins of government - this will be the best gift. However, on the same day the woman finds out that in her hometown where Gleb often goes on a business trip, her husband has another woman and a little daughter. Happy plans for the future are collapsing, Tatiana decides to break all relations with her husband. But then Gleb has a heart attack ...

name: Chosen
summary: Shortly after arriving in Sydney, Australia, a brilliant heart surgeon visiting from China is drawn into a deadly game whereby he must kill a stranger or lose somebody close to him. Our hero unexpectedly finds himself at the centre of a deadly, complex game when he is delivered a box with a murderous message. As a doctor dedicated to preserving life, he refuses to play - he refuses to kill. Then those he loves most, his family, come under threat. Kidnap and murder are just the start. This is the thrilling story of a man fighting against impossible odds to bring his family to safety, using everything at his disposal to outwit his unknown opponents amidst terrible danger.

name: Aggretsuko
summary: Frustrated with her thankless office job, Retsuko the Red Panda copes with her daily struggles by belting out death metal karaoke after work.

name: Соломоново решение
summary:
Nadia works as a cashier in a supermarket in a small provincial town. She lives modestly with her son, Sanka. Suddenly she has a serious heart disease - she needs a heart transplant. Nadia, taking her son and cat, goes to the capital, where she is expected in a charity fund. She meets the employee of the foundation Olga and her friend Alena. While Nadia is in the hospital, Alena takes Sanka in and takes care of him. When it turns out that the fund can not help Nadia, she transfers custody of Sanka to Alena. The boy remains in the capital, and Nadia returns to her native city to die.

However, after a while the donor heart is found for Nadia and she returns to the capital. Sanka lives with Alena and misses his mom. After a successful operation, Nadia wants to regain her son, but faces Alena's resistance. She is a legal guardian, and does not intend to return the child she is attached to.

name: The Charlotte Show
summary: She's the feisty Geordie lass we can't get enough of - and now she's got her very own MTV reality show. Get ready for Charlotte Crosby's brand new series - The Charlotte Show! Access all areas of Charlotte's work, life and relationships as we follow the lass on her travels to Australia, Ireland and more. We'll be getting up close and personal with her mam, her BFF and of course her three cute AF dogs. Since shooting to fame on Geordie Shore, Charlotte's gone on to become a TV presenter, fashion designer and fitness mentor. With millions of social media followers, she is papped and written about daily in the national press and has had to live out some of her most personal moments in the glare of the media spotlight. Now it's time for fans to find out what really goes on behind the scenes in Charlotte's life - warts and all. Get ready for fun, adventure and (probably) a few mortal moments along the way!

name: Heidi
summary: Heidi was a Japanese animated series based on the popular Heidi series of books.

name: Park Jin Young's Party People
summary: Park Jin Young's Party People allows the audience to freely enjoy the comfortable atmosphere with guest singers. They would make small talks on music while striking interest to draw in the audience to become part of the show. It cannot be compared to other ordinary music talk shows. Be sure to check out the utmost honest charms of the stars through Park Jin Young's Party People.

name: Til Lease Do Us Part
summary: After a couple breaks up, they realize they have six months left on their lease.

name: Number Woman Gye Sook Ja
summary: This web-drama revolves around development team manager Gye Sook Ja, a woman in her thirties who trusts in numbers and judges the world accordingly.

name: London Kills
summary: Drama series following the detectives of an elite murder investigation squad in London.

name: Salty Tour
summary: Salty Tour is a travel variety program that emphasises on two things: good quality for the price and small luxury. For every city/country, three of the cast members are assigned as one-day tour guides and are given the same budget per person. The cast members will attempt to have the best vacation experience with a fixed price limit. The Small Luxury can only be won by the winning tour guide through the judging of the remaining cast members and invited guests for each day tour.

name: Amazing f(x)
summary: Amazing f(x) is a South Korean documentary reality show starring the popular South Korean girl group f(x). 'Amazing f(x)' will be the f(x)'s third reality show.

name: Bachelor in Paradise
summary: Bachelor in Paradise Australia follows former Bachelor and Bachelorette contestants on their second chance quest to find true love.

name: Vampire Idol
summary: A naive vampire prince from Vampire planet visits Earth to see a live performance of his favorite idol contender. He remains stuck on Earth with his three trusted and loyal servants. He then decides to join the competition himself and struggles to become a global pop idol.

name: I Don't Like Mondays
summary: I Don't Like Mondays is a game show hosted by Alan Carr. In every show, one of the studio audience will win a paid year off work! The winner of each show gets to walk away with not only a year's salary, but also an amazing prize pot of things to do with their time off.

name: Come Fly with Me
summary: Five couples are flown to a location in the world and they compete in various challenges. Whichever couple comes last in each of the challenges are then sent home on the next plane so in the space of 24 hours four of the five couples would not only have flown to the place in question but would have flown back home too. The winners get to stay for an all expenses paid holiday.

name: Before the Fringe
summary: A sketch comedy series highlighting some of the up and coming new comedic talents.

name: Lion Country
summary: Following David Youldon and his colleagues at the African Lion & Environmental Research Trust in Zimbabwe as they run a controversial programme designed to halt the declining population of the animals. At the centre, captive lions are encouraged to develop their natural skills so they can live independently and their offspring can be released into the wild.

name: Smith and Jones Sketchbook
summary: Mel Smith and Griff Rhys Jones are reunited to present the best of ten series of Smith and Jones. Plus, updated versions of their famous head-to-head talking routines.

name: The Planets
summary: Well-known astronomers Nigel Henbest & Heather Couper host this show, crossing time and space to discover the secrets of the planets, their past, present and future. Using their knowledge of science and astronomy, they tell us the truth about the human race's home and the other planets where perhaps others lifeforms exist.

name: Runaways
summary: Following the work of the National Missing Persons Helpline to explore the mysteries behind the thousands of people reported missing in the UK every year.

name: Loving
summary: Loving takes place in the fictional town of Corinth, PA, centering around the lives of the wealthy Alden family. Love and betrayal, along with the struggle for power, become the focus of this long-running drama.

name: Housing Yorkshire: Somewhere to Call Home
summary: Documentary series set across the UK's largest county, following frontline officers at one of the country's biggest social housing providers.

name: Yasha
summary:
The story is about a set of twin baby boys who were created/cloned in the laboratory as a part of gene altering/gene therapy experiment. Because of the nature of the project, the twins were born with superior physical strength, supernatural powers and extremely high IQ. Unfortunately, the twins were separated at birth. One of the brothers, Sei, grew up to be an elite bio-chemistry scientist in America. He was assigned to a project where he has to travel to a small island in Japan to investigate an unidentified virus that is spreading on the island. By a freak of nature, he found out that he has a twin brother, Rin, whose evil, dark personality is entirely opposite of him.

What is going to happen when they finally meet face to face? What are their true identities? Why were they separated at birth, what other secrets are hidden from them? Does the fast spreading virus has anything to do with the twins? Who created them? And why?

previousepisode.name: Futari no yasha, nikushimi to ai no hate ni

name: Blunder
summary: Blunder is an ensemble sketch show written and performed by six of the UK's brightest young comedy writers and performers: David Mitchell, Simon Farnaby, Rhys Thomas, Nina Conti, Tom Meeten and Tony Way. The series features a colourful array of cartoonish characters and oddballs, shot live before a studio audience.

name: Frontiers
summary: Eight writers, with special reasons to care, journey along some of the most critical frontiers in the world.

name: Ari og halve kongeriket
summary: The whole of Norway knows Ari Behn. He even says that the story about himself in public is a staging. But who is the peacock, the artist and the author behind the mask? Join Ari on the journey in the difficult year after divorce, when he finally has to find his place and find out who he really is.

name: Camp Kulinaris
summary: 10 new expectant celebrities are ready to run a restaurant in Portør. The gang all have varying kitchen skills, but together they must both cooperate and fight against each other to find out who is the best.

name: Frusna vägar
summary: Join a sparkling Sweden far up in the north where snow and ice are everyday for both bearers and snowmen, but not as comfortable for big city residents on a temporary visit. In Frozen roads, we go out on the roads along with the heroes who turn the northern borders into dangerous areas, despite Kung Boro's hard resistance. When the wind suddenly sweeps into the sparkling fields in snowy wrecking, the roads shine glashala and the drifting snow forms piles, then they have never longed so much for the heroes of the winter roads.

name: Svenska nyheter
summary: Jesper Rönndahl is leading the satire program to explain why things are as they are, and how they should be, and joking about politics and politics. The weekly program deals with the biggest domestic news, focusing on a major subject.

name: Tina i fjällen
summary: Tina Nordström invites exciting guests to Lofoten and Svalbard. Tina takes guests from everything from kayaking to surfing and roller coaster safaris. There will also be cooking in a unique environment and confidential conversation.

name: Kockakademin
summary: In the new cooking program Kockakademin, ten young chef talents compete for his big dream job: a job as a chef at Johan Jureskog's award-winning restaurant AG in Stockholm. Under the leadership of Jureskog - and with guest invitations of several other star chefs - the contestants get to learn more about the cooking art and stand against each other in tough competitions. In addition, they live together during the racing season in a luxury villa just outside of Stockholm, which gives a wonderful cookie of cooking and reality.

name: Lailaland
summary: Laila Bagge wants to get the most out of life. She wants to be a good mom, carry out all her dreams, constantly take on new projects, have fun, develop, help others, feel loved and have deep relationships. With very many balls in the air at the same time it can easily be chaos, but after all she is (almost) always in control. At the end of the day there is only one thing that is really important to her; family. We are following Laila Bagge, who dares to share his privacy more than ever before, and the son of Liam, whose life revolves around studies, martial arts, family and friends.

name: Århundrets stemme
summary: Who manages a hundred years of hits? It is the big challenge in a singing contest where ten famous artists will compete against each other on the live stream. Every Saturday there is music from the new decades on the poster, and it is the television viewers who decide which of the artists will be allowed on - until there is one winner left.

name: Alle mot 1
summary: In this one-of-a-kind game show, one person will take on the entire country in trying to become the last standing champion of Alle mot 1.

name: Stjärnornas stjärna
summary: Eight artists perform in a musical multiplayer where they perform interpretations of famous hits from completely different music styles than they are used to. A panel gives them feedback and every week a participant must leave the contest, who will be up to the viewers.

name: Eventyrlige nordmenn
summary: Have you ever dreamed of packing the bag to do something completely different? Øyvind Fjeldheim and Guri Solberg have traveled around the world to meet Norwegians who have followed the dream and traveled to realize it.

name: Robert og Herman
summary: Robert Stoltenberg and Herman Flesvig's popular characters take vacation and travel in the cabin.

name: Danskebåten
summary: Danskebåten is a docusoap showcasing the whole spectrum of life aboard Stena Saga, from the people in the engine room to the captain on the bridge, and the rest of the crew that work so that the passengers get the best trip possible. And of course, there are also meetings with many of the guests, whether they are families on a trip or regular travelers with many crossings a year.

name: Asia Insight
summary: Dynamic Asia. Stories behind the world's largest continent as it faces political, economic, cultural and technological change.

name: Hometown Stories
summary: With themes ranging from ancient traditions to contemporary social issues, these documentaries present intimate portraits of people's lives around Japan today.

previousepisode.name: My Favorite Meal, One Last Time

name: Inside Lens
summary:
Inside Lens is a series by NHK World TV that broadcasts documentaries directed by filmmakers living in Asia. We air documentaries that highlight local communities as the lens through which the dynamism of modern Asia is portrayed.

Inside Lens has two different formats. The first format is the documentaries about Asia directed by Asian filmmakers including foreign filmmakers who have lived in Asia for several years. There are many Asian filmmakers who have unique lens to depict the society closely and at the same time they are trying to co-produce the film with overseas broadcasters or production companies. "Unique lens" and "co-production" are the key words of the first type.

The second format is the documentaries about Japan directed by foreign filmmakers living in Japan. The documentaries should be rooted in the present tense that tell relevant and timely stories about what Japan is facing today.

We encourage innovative and intelligent filmmaking that speaks of the concerns of Asia and Japan today. Inside Lens is for ambitious, emerging filmmakers willing to develop projects to engage with NHK World's worldwide audiences that have interest in Asia and Japan. Strong narratives and captivating characters are essential prerequisites.

name: Science View
summary: Science for our future. Cutting edge research, innovation and technology being created by Japanese scientists and engineers.

previousepisode.name: Digging for Dinosaurs with Digital Technology

name: Face to Face
summary: Face to Face is a monthly talk show with the people making a difference in Japanese society today. The show's host is Robert Campbell, who is an expert in Japanese literature and culture.

name: Sumopedia
summary:
Sumo is without a doubt, one of the most Japanese of sports, boasting a history of more than 1500 years. We bring you daily highlights from the Grand Sumo Tournament held 6 times a year. See how powerful wrestlers with an average weight of more than 160 kilos clash in the sacred ring in a bid to claim the Emperor's Cup.

Also don't miss "Sumopedia", our short introductions to sumo's profound history and fascinating trivia that airs every day after the highlight show.

name: Förlåt mig
summary: Förlåt mig is an emotional reality series where regrettable people will do some of the hardest things available - ask for forgiveness. It's about loved ones, family members or close friends as they hurt and lost contact.

name: J-MELO
summary: J-MELO is the only Japanese music show in English. It's packed with hits, exclusive performances and interviews, and lots more on every imaginable kind of Japanese music.

name: Kids Meet the World
summary: The forthcoming Tokyo 2020 Olympic now induces the flowering of the international exchange among Japanese society. In order to broadcast the various positive effects in each location, the research groups of the kids are assembled by this program. Kids meet the world through creating their unique video reports.

previousepisode.name: Making Videos, Making Friends: Miyagi Meets Palau

name: Seventeen
summary: At Seventeen, we were all newbies at love. These are innocent and reckless high school love stories that we dare not think of doing now.

name: Sagas of Sundry
summary: There's a sound somewhere in the darkness. Lights flicker across the campsite. Your hands shake, palms sweating. You make your move, hold your breath, and hope that the jenga tower doesn't fall over. Welcome to the horror RPG, Dread.

name: Kiss: The Series
summary: Sandee is an university student who is often surrounded with male friends and considered to be their buddy. One morning, she wakes up only to find herself naked in Thada's bed, who is one of her friends. Confused and shocked, they cannot remember whether they did anything during the night because they were both drunk. Now they are trying to hide this from their other friends because they do not want to destroy their friendship. However, it seems that you cannot hide falling in love forever...

name: Delicious Love
summary: A teen romantic comedy that tells the story of a chef named Sung Jun who is the best at his craft and has no flaws in the eyes of others, but he is simply hopeless when it comes to love. But when he meets a girl who eats everything deliciously, he falls in love at first sight.

name: Unfinished Business
summary: Ten years ago, Spike, abandoned Amy and ran off to Paris with his mistress. Amy never quite recovered from the shock and has spent all that time in therapy trying to come to terms with Spike's betrayal. Amy thinks she has recovered when her lover falls in love with and moves in with her own daughter and she finds herself back at square one, alone and miserable, with only the young, beautiful, popular, cynical Tanya to comfort her. Completely out of the blue Amy and Spike literally crash into one another again in a car wash. Is there still a spark left burning between them or will past hurt and pain prevent them from reuniting?

name: James Acaster: Repertoire
summary: James Acaster: Repertoire comprises four live stand-up shows that all exist in the same universe and follow the same running narrative, coming together to form a serialised stand-up mini-series.

name: The Zen Diaries of Garry Shandling
summary:
When Garry Shandling passed away in 2016, he was widely remembered as a top stand-up comic and the star of two of the most innovative sitcoms in TV history. But to those who knew him, the "real" Garry Shandling was a far more complex person. Now, Judd Apatow has created a remarkable portrait of this iconic comedian in the four-and-a-half-hour documentary The Zen Diaries of Garry Shandling.

Epic in scope and intimate in detail, The Zen Diaries of Garry Shandling features conversations with more than 40 of Shandling's family and friends, including James L. Brooks, Jim Carrey, Sacha Baron Cohen, David Coulier, Jon Favreau, Jay Leno, Kevin Nealon, Conan O'Brien, Bob Saget, Jerry Seinfeld and Sarah Silverman, and four decades' worth of TV appearances, along with personal journals, private letters and candid home audio and video footage that reveal his brilliant mind and restless soul.

name: Now Apocalypse
summary: Now Apocalypse is a a surreal, coming-of-age comedy that follows Ulysses and his friends Carly, Ford and Severine, who are on various quests pursuing love, sex and fame in Los Angeles. Between sexual and romantic dating app adventures, Ulysses grows increasingly troubled as foreboding premonitory dreams make him wonder if some kind of dark and monstrous conspiracy going on, or is he just smoking too much weed?

name: Farmen VIP
summary: Far from the modern society, a number of celebrities are challenged to live as farmers did in the 19th century. In addition to living as in the past, it is a tough competition with tactics and rack games. Program leader is Paolo Roberto.

name: Stockholmspolisen
summary: In TV4's new documentary series Stockholm Police, viewers can follow the police's work in Sweden's capital close up. How does one day or night look at work for the police who make a difference in our streets during each workout?

name: En Kveld Hos Kloppen
summary: Solveig Kloppen invites three famous people to whom she is curious and fascinated by the home for a nice evening in the train Hageby.

previousepisode.name: Trygve Slagsvold Vedum, Ingeborg Heldal, Jarle Bernhoft

name: Storuman Forever
summary: The real couple Björn Ferry and Heidi Andersson want to live a completely fossil-free life, and want to bring their entire home town - Storuman - on the train.

name: Idag om ett år
summary: Here we can join when people with will, strength and courage take on the challenges of their lives to make a change in their lives. What takes a whole year for the participants, we can see from start to finish in just a few minutes. Program leader is Pernilla Månsson Colt.

name: BTS: Burn the Stage
summary: BTS: Burn the Stage follows the 300-day journey of the band's sold-out world tour, 2017 BTS Live Trilogy Episode: The Wings Tour. This show is an intimate, personal portrayal dedicated to each other and to their fans across the globe. It celebrates the triumph of their friendship as they overcome shared hardships, and shows the growth and hard work as BTS continues on the path to grow into fully-fledged artists.

name: Påskefjellet
summary: Guri Solberg and Olaf Tufte have gone to the mountains to give the viewers good Easter eve. They have brought famous guests for good conversations and Easter activities. In the ski slope, skiers and boarders show us Easter's most beautiful skiing and we meet one of the mountain heroes - the volunteers who make sure we are safe and safe at Easter eve.

name: Chevaleresk
summary: Chevaleresk, the lifestyles program deepened in male style, is back. After the first season, Måns Zelmerlöw and Alexander Wiberg were nominated by the viewers of the TV award Kristallen as "Best Man Program Manager of the Year". Then through the series they had portrayed the modern gentleman. Now they are heading for a roadtrip in Sweden and Europe to explore typical Chevalar activities.

name: Hemliga beundrare
summary: In Hemliga beundrare we follow people who are finally daring to take the step and confront the people they've secretly admired for ages. How will the surprise date go and will sparks fly?

name: To Love, To Heal
summary: The usually bright teacher Xiao Shui Guang becomes depressed after losing her boyfriend. Because of an incident at school, she gets to know the older brother of one of the students Zhang Zheng Lan, who is the boss of a games company. Zheng Lan discovers that Shui Guang is the one who once gave him the idea for a game and starts to pursue her. He soon realizes that she closed herselfoff and thus promises her: "You protect your secret and I will protect you."

name: Demolition
summary: Series following demolition crews as they smash, crush and blast their way through the UK's unwanted buildings.

name: Only Side by Side with You
summary: Nan Qiao has an ugly breakup with cheating fiance Zhou Ran, who then withdraws all his capital from her drone designing business and prevents other potential investors from funding the company. Shi Yue decides to invest in Nan Qiao's company after discovering that she may be the reason why he went from aspiring soldier to gigolo and nightclub owner. However Shi Yue's revenge plans fall by the wayside when he develops romantic feelings for Nan Qiao.

name: Shaun the Sheep Championsheeps
summary: Life on the farm becomes a hive of athletic activity as Shaun and friends stage their very own sporting extravaganza.

name: Abbey and Janice: Beauty and the Best
summary: Two huge personalities, one incredible ambition, a series of set-piece challenges and a whole heap of conflict all make for an unforgettable series. Abbey Clancy is a girl with ambition. After a crack at the modelling business in the UK she's got her sights set on bigger and better things: the US. And who better to assist her than the woman who put the super into supermodel, the legendary Janice Dickinson.

name: Benny Hill
summary: A sitcom where Benny Hill played a different role every week.

name: Commercial Breakdown with Jimmy Carr
summary: Jimmy Carr presents a selection of the world's funniest and weirdest TV adverts.

name: I Love the 1980s
summary: Series celebrating 1980s pop culture.

name: Last Choir Standing
summary: Myleene Klass and Nick Knowles host the search for Britain's best choir.

name: The Afternoon Play
summary: Series of one-off dramas.

name: Affairs of the Heart
summary: After Peter Bonamy suffers a heart attack, and subsequently leaves hospital, he leads his life more carefully than before. His wife Jane and daughter Rosemary molly-coddle him, and he also attends a heart-attack survivors group. Bonamy, from the comfort of his south London home, finds himself doing little, especially as he can not even drive his Porsche.

name: Darrow & Darrow
summary: Claire Darrow, a lawyer, fights for what's right, regardless of whether it makes her a dime. Joanna, Claire's estranged mother and a lawyer as well, would rather make a profit. They clash on nearly everything, even on the best way to raise Claire's daughter, Louise.

name: Jonathan Ross' Asian Invasion
summary: Jonathan Ross travels to Japan, Hong Kong and Korea to explore the world's most innovative cinema. He meets Asia's most talked about actors and directors and shares his passion for all aspects of Asian filmmaking with a multitude of clips.

name: The Vault
summary: General knowledge quiz show with a big cash prize.

name: Help
summary: Help concerns a psychotherapist and his therapy sessions with a variety of patients.

name: Forged in Fire: Knife or Death
summary: Forged in Fire: Knife or Death features fearless competitors as they race against the clock putting their blades and blade-wielding skills through a grueling gauntlet of challenges such as slicing through flying watermelons, hacking through massive ice blocks and severing various types of ropes, tubes, metals and item-filled crates.

name: Крещение Руси
summary: Крещение Руси (The Birth of a Nation) features a wonderful period in the history, associated with the advent and spreading of Christianity in the territory of ancient Rus. The viewers will learn how the views and religious beliefs of the people of that time was evolving and what whey consisted of, how political mentality was changing, how what we know now as the Old Russian culture and spirituality – the things that shaped the great Holy Russia with its millennial history and uninterrupted connection with the present day – was being born.

name: Badass Bitches of History
summary: Jenny Zigrino loves history and hates the patriarchy, as do her guests, badass women from across time.

name: Hubert ohne Staller
summary:
Despite their mismatched styles, police officer partners Hubert and Staller rely on teamwork as they investigate murder cases in rural Bavaria.

From seasons one through seven, the series was called Hubert and Staller. After Helmfried von Lüttichau left, the title was changed to Hubert ohne Staller.

name: Kompani Spitsbergen
summary: At Longyearbyen in Svalbard lies the last Norwegian coal mine still in operation - Mine 7. In the series about one of Norway's toughest jobs, we follow a fused gang of miners. We get to know a small group of people, where good friendship and loyalty can really mean the difference between life and death.

name: A Seaside Parish
summary: Documentary series following Rev Christine Musser in her Cornish parish.

name: Momo Salon
summary: An aspiring hair designer named Hye Ni and an unemployed candidate named Chang Gyoon have a chance meeting at the newly opened "Momo Salon!"

name: Magic Ring
summary: Xiao Jun slowly wakes up from a train accident. Losing all her memories and left with amnesia, Xiao Jun has no idea who she is or where she is going. Yet the ancient ring that she is wearing on her finger is proof of being the Du family's eldest son's fiancé. Therefore, Xiao Jun is confusingly brought to the rich and powerful Du family. The head of the Du family treats her and loves her as if she is his own daughter, causing the pregnant Xiao Jun to experience the feelings of a warm family that she has never felt before.

name: Mon Rak Asun
summary: Nampeung, a teacher on a district school, faces lots of problems when she is unable to secure herself a permanent position in her district school, and her father contracts a disease that affects his eyesight. Moreover, her father takes a mortgage for the property by striking a deal with Sia Songyod, and if she can't pay back on time, her property will be occupied or she has to be the mistress ofSia Songyod. Her father's friend, who works with Terd, advises her to work with Terd by teaching Naan, Terd's son. But Terd has a drinking addiction and Naan is aggressive.

name: The Glamour Girls
summary: The Glamour Girls tells the story of two young women - Veronica and Debbie - who quit their jobs and decide to work as promotional girls at an agency. They quickly realise that life in sales is not as glamorous as they'd hoped it would be.

name: Out of the Blue
summary: Set in Sydney beach suburb of Manly, New South Wales, Out of the Blue is a drama about a group of thirty-year-old friends returning home for a high school reunion, which is brought to an end when someone is murdered. An investigation follows as the group attempts to discover which one of them was the killer.

name: Tijuana Toads
summary: The hilarious adventures of two toads, Toro and Pancho, who live in the Mexican city of Tijuana. Throughout the cartoon they try to eat their prey, but always get out-smarted. They would sometimes themselves be targeted by a bird, Crazylegs Crane, and would in turn always out-smart him.

name: Kerry Katona: Crazy in Love
summary: Kerry Katona: Crazy in Love follows her and husband Mark Croft as they prepare for the birth of their baby.

name: My Unfortunate Boyfriend
summary: Yoon Tae Woon is a man who believes in living truthfully, so he is honest to a fault. On the other hand, Yoo Ji Na is a woman who has no qualms about lying to get what she wants. She is just starting out at a corporate job, determined to succeed at any cost. The drama will demonstrate how their unlikely romance turns out to be true love.

name: The Royal Today
summary: Lively contemporary spin-off from the hugely successful ITV series The Royal, set in the same Yorkshire hospital 40 years on.

name: Avlu
summary: A woman entering a prison trying to establish her own justice. These women who are forced to give up their freedom are struggling in Karakuyu against their own order and their own laws.

name: Love Pub
summary: A story about the love and growth of young people who work in a pub.

name: Girls in Love
summary: Ellie Allard is a typical teenager with a passion for art, she gets up to loads of trouble with her best friends, goth Nadine and flirty Magda.

name: Football Behind Bars
summary: This series will document what life is like at Portland Young Offenders Institution in Dorset and follow Ian's work to help the inmates create their own football academy to play in, instilling them with a sense of pride, achievement and motivating them towards a better future. They will also be taught essential life skills and given positive role models as an example of how their futures can be changed for the better.

name: The Cell
summary: Dr. Adam Rutherford tells the extraordinary story of the scientific quest to discover the secrets of the cell and of life itself.

name: Forgotten
summary: Ben Turner is a happily married man in his late thirties who owns a used book shop and helps his wife run an inn in a small town in England. When a young local girl is found murdered in the woods, Ben has more than the safety of his own daughter to worry about. For his real name is Peter Baxter, and in his late teens he was convicted of child murder and spent years in prison. Now a woman moves into the inn and starts asking pointed questions.

name: The Trap: What Happened to Our Dream of Freedom
summary: Adam Curtis explores the origins of our contemporary idea of freedom.

previousepisode.name: We Will Force You To Be Free

name: The Crusades
summary: The story of the Crusades is remembered as a tale of religious fanaticism and unspeakable brutality, but using fresh evidence, Dr. Thomas Asbridge re-examines this medieval drama.

name: Summits
summary: David Reynolds, Professor of International History at Cambridge University, uncovers the fascinating behind-the-scenes story of three ground-breaking summit meetings that have shaped the modern world.

name: The Bear Family and Me
summary: Join wildlife cameraman, Gordon Buchanan, as he tries to gain the trust of a wild bear family in a spectacular American wilderness.

name: Unexplained
summary: Tony Robinson and science journalist Becky McCall step into the unknown to investigate whether past paranormal events should be taken seriously or dumped into history's litterbin.

previousepisode.name: Tony Robinson and the Medieval Reincarnation

name: Nicholas Crane's Britannia: The Great Elizabethan Journey
summary: Nicholas Crane rediscovers the 'lost' masterpiece Britannia on an epic 5000 mile hike battling the elements in search of Elizabethan Britain.

name: Million Dollar Traders
summary: Eight ordinary people are given a million dollars and a fortnight of intensive training to run their own hedge fund. Hedge fund manager Lex van Dam wants to see if they can beat the professionals.

name: The Baron
summary:
Three television and music personalities, Mike Reid, Malcolm McLaren and Suzanne Shaw, head to Gardenstown, Banffshire, near Aberdeenshire in the North East of Scotland. Their aim was to become a part of the fishing village within the two weeks they were living in Gardenstown.

After trying to become part of the community the 1000 local villagers took part in a secret ballot to vote for one of the three celebrities to become the Laird with the title The 13th Baron of Troup.

name: Little Devil
summary: When Laura Crowe becomes tired of her devoted husband Will, she turns her affections to his best friend Adrian. With Will busy with his job as a headmaster, he hasn't noticed that Laura is playing away. However, it's a different story for the children of both Laura and Adrian who soon uncover the harsh truth that could destroy their families.

name: The Life of Muhammad
summary: Rageh Omaar investigates the life of the man considered by Muslims to be the prophet responsible for the final revelation of Islam as well as the spread of the Muslim faith.

name: The Queen's Palaces
summary: Fiona Bruce fronts this eye-opening new three-part series on the stories behind Britain's official royal residences: Buckingham Palace, Windsor Castle and Palace of Holyroodhouse.

name: Croc Man
summary: For the past five years, Shaun Foggett and his wife Lisa have lived with their young family and a collection of crocodiles at their home in Whitney, Oxfordshire. This series follows Shaun's five-month journey as he gives up life as a carpenter to follow his dream of opening the UK's first crocodile zoo.

name: Hugh's Chicken Run
summary: In three hard-hitting programmes, Hugh Fearnley-Whittingstall explores the horrors of intensive chicken farming. The journey takes him far from the cosy lifestyle of River Cottage and into the harrowing conditions of running his own modern poultry production line.

name: Candy Bar Girls
summary: A group of lesbians living in London let cameras follow their lives as they work hard and party harder in and around the Soho establishment.

name: Amir Khan's Angry Young Men
summary: Boxing superstar and devout Muslim, Amir Khan turns Mentor in this exciting, inspirational new series. Amir takes eight young men under his wing, drawn from some of Britain's most deprived areas, and puts them through his very own transformation programme. The young men have the privilege of observing Amir at close quarters, drawing inspiration from how he lives his life. This series is a truly transformational journey for all involved.

name: Mike Tyson: Raw and Uncut
summary: Mike Tyson: Raw and Uncut looks at Mike Tyson's unprecedented rise to the pinnacle of world boxing.

name: Cursed
summary: Cursed is told through the eyes of Nimue, the Lady of the Lake character from the King Arthur legend. Nimue is a teenager with a mysterious gift, and the series shows how she came to be on the road to her destiny. After her mother dies, Nimue joins a young mercenary named Arthur, on his quest to find the magician Merlin and deliver an ancient sword. The future Lady of the Lake become a symbol of courage and rebellion against the terrifying Red Paladins, and their complicit King Uther.

name: imagine-nation
summary: Comics, Anime and Games are now a globally popular form of entertainment from Japan. This 30 minute magazine program features Japan's ranking of the most popular titles from each genre. The program also has long interviews with Japan's top creators, as well as delivering information on upcoming related events.

name: Den glemte polarhelt
summary: Carsten Borchgrevink has an impetus that promises to be an unknown sailor to become the great hero. He led the world's first winter expedition expedition in Antarctica in 1898. Through a trip back to his cabin on the stormy Cape Adare, we will reveal why Carsten Borchgrevink ended up being poor and unknown.

name: Ik Heb Het Nog Nooit Gedaan
summary: This is a show about people that are still virgins, despite being of age for a long time. The show tells the story of people on their way to losing their virginity.

name: Идеальная пара
summary: Adventurous adventure story, the main characters of which are two smart swindler - He and She. Two elegant, educated, quite respectable people who are engaged in enchanting scams.

name: Haiku Masters
summary: From Japan's most famous haiku locations, Haiku Masters introduces Photo Haikus sent in from around the world with its unique take on the art form, creating the ultimate social haiku experience.

name: Länge leve demokratin
summary: Join Jan Scherman on a long journey through the Swedish powerline.

name: Bake Decorate Celebrate!
summary:
Its time to Bake, Decorate and Celebrate! you're invited to celebrate all of the occasions in your life with sweet treats. No prior experience needed — cake decorating has never been so easy and fun with hosts Nancy Siler.

Each week includes a feature theme and specialty cakes for that occasion plus adaptations for other events. We also have a second related project with other ideas for that celebration. And last we feature a third project with related ideas for that special party.

Each week also features 2 tips. The first is Decorating Basics — easy first steps for successful baking. The second tip — is actually a "decorating" tip! We feature a different cake decorating tip each week and easy instructions on how to achieve beautiful designs with just that tip.

Make every day a party with Bake Decorate Celebrate!

name: Keiji Yugami
summary: Yukimasa Yugami is a detective who chases after facts in cases. He will resort to illegal investigations and he uses his unique reasoning powers. His partner is rookie detective Torao Hanyu.

name: ДНК
summary:
On NTV - an acutely social talk show "DNA". The heroes of the program are ordinary families, for whom a DNA test is the only way to end bitter disputes between relatives.

Thanks to the genetic examination, program guests have the opportunity to establish paternity and demand payment of alimony, confirm kinship and reunite with relatives, identify legal heirs and learn more about their ancestry. Any person who finds himself in a difficult life situation can become a hero of the program and take a DNA test for free.

name: Resurrection
summary: The story of a man's struggle to atone for a crime committed in youth. It results in his discovery of a new way of life.

name: Forever
summary: A woman framed for murdering a pregnant woman in Spain is given a life sentence. Out after 18 years, she returns home to find the real killer.

previousepisode.name: A Death and a New Family

name: Survivor
summary:
Survivor is the British reality game show based on the popular international reality franchise of the same name.

The show follows the same general format as the other editions of the show. The players are split between two "tribes", are taken to a remote island and are forced to live off the land with meager supplies for an extended period of time. Frequent physical and mental challenges are used to pit the teams against each other for rewards, such as food or luxuries, or for "immunity", forcing the other tribe to attend "Tribal Council", where they must vote off one of their players.

Once about half the players are remaining, the remaining players are merged into a single tribe, and competitions are on an individual basis; winning immunity prevents that player from being voted out. Most players that are voted out at this stage form the "Tribal Council Jury". Once down to two people, a final Tribal Council is held where the remaining players plead their case to the Jury as to why they should win the game. The jury then votes for which player should be considered the "Ultimate Survivor" and be awarded the grand prize of £1,000,000.

name: Dip
summary: Sahir, who is in charge of abandoning the people who attempt to commit suicide due to Istanbul Security, finds Bilge who is a scientist woman with a notice coming to the phone one day.

name: Paul Merton in India
summary: Having conquered China, comedian Paul Merton has his sights set on India, an astonishingly diverse country of one billion people. Paul intends to beat his own path around this enormous subcontinent, shunning the traditional tourist spots in favour of unexpected sights and surprising detours, to see ‘his India'.

name: The Persuasionists
summary: Sitcom set in the advertising industry.

name: The Children
summary: When the body of an eight-year-old girl is discovered in a garden, the chain of events leading up to her death begin to merge. Six months earlier, and three couples embark on exciting new relationships, blissfully unaware of the tragic consequences.

name: Bob & Rose
summary: A very light-hearted series, which centres itself around the lives of two very likeable and warm characters, Bob and Rose. Bob is gay, and Rose has a boyfriend. They meet up by accident in a street one night, and their lives begin to slowly change, and a relationship begins to develop between them. But that's only just the beginning...

name: Beeny's Restoration Nightmare
summary: Property expert Sarah Beeny takes on the biggest challenge of her career as she tries to save Rise Hall in East Yorkshire from ruin. She and husband Graham have lived in the stately home for the past 10 years and plan to transform it into a wedding and events venue in just nine months. On a shoe-string budget, they must tackle 97 rooms with rising damp, an acre of leaking roofs and a third of a mile of corridors.

name: The Adam and Joe Show
summary: The Adam and Joe Show was a sketch series featuring the talents of Adam Buxton and Joe Cornish. As well as starring in the show they also wrote and directed it. The series was filmed in their from their bedsit in Brixton, London.

name: Food
summary: Food is a magazine show that attempts to inform the public about everything they need to know about the food they buy and how it is produced. The series is filmed at the Laverstoke Park Farm and the presenters offer advise on most topical food subjects so that the viewers have the best consumer advice available and are also offered tips on the cheapest ways to fill their shopping trolleys.

name: Wired
summary: As single mum, Louise Evans, is given a promotion at her bank only to be coerced into facilitating a £250 million internet bank theft. Wired is a thriller about bank fraud, what happens to our money behind the scenes in the world of "electronic banking", and the shadowy bank robbers who no longer operate with masks and sawn-off shotguns.

name: The Time of Your Life
summary: Kate, a 37-year old woman wakes up after being in a coma for 18 years. Her boyfriend, Pete, from her younger days is with a new woman who bears an uncanny resemblance to Kate. Many of her friends have also moved on with their lives. But when she finds out that her comatose body was discovered near the lifeless body of a kid named Brian near a woodshed, her memories of that fateful night are triggered and the truth begins to surface.

name: Star Cops
summary: Star Cops follows Nathan Spring and the rest of his multinational team of the International Space Police (Star Cops) as they work to establish the Star Cops and solve whatever crimes come their way. Operating in a relatively accurately realised hard SF, near-future, space environment, many of the cases that the Star Cops investigate arise from opportunities for new crimes presented by the technologically advanced future society the series depicts and from the hostile frontier nature of the environment that the Star Cops live in.

previousepisode.name: Little Green Men and Other Martians

name: Grimefighters
summary: Series following the daily lives of Britain's clean up teams, including pest controllers, restaurant inspectors and litter pickers.

name: Touch Me, I'm Karen Taylor
summary: Sketch show co-written by and starring comedian Karen Taylor. Expect a fresh and saucy look at modern life as Karen welcomes us to a world as seen through her irreverent and lascivious eyes.

name: Doctor in Charge
summary: Doctor in Charge is a comedy series based on a set of books by Richard Gordon about the misadventures of a group of doctors.

name: Build a New Life in the Country
summary: Build a New Life in the Country follows people leaving the rat-race of the city in pursuit of new lifestyles and new homes in the countryside. The dream houses they are creating are inspiring, architecturally challenging and are all undertaken with a modest budget.

name: Karppi
summary: Just months after a tragic loss, detective Sofia Karppi investigates the murder of a woman with ties to a Helsinki construction company.

name: Soratobu Kouhoushitsu
summary: Inaba Rika is a director at Teito TV Network. Ever since her childhood it was been her dream to be a reporter. Yet she frequently causes troubles due to her aggressive interviewing style and eventually gets transferred against her will to be the co-director of an evening information programme. She is put in charge of a special feature on uniformed personnel and ordered to interview the Self Defence Forces. First Lieutenant Sorai Daisuke became a fighter pilot but injured his foot in an accident and got assigned to a department which he was unprepared for, the Air Staff Office's Public Relations Department. Ever since the accident, he has never once shown his feelings. However, Daisuke's superior Sagisaka saw through his "benign, mild" facade and placed Rika in his care even though the people around him said he was still not ready for it. It chafes at Rika to have her dream destroyed and she psyches herself for a comeback as a reporter by getting a scoop. With that in mind, she is constantly provocative in her speech and conduct towards the members of the Public Relations Department, especially Daisuke. And she says something to Daisuke that she never should...

previousepisode.name: Reunited After 2 Years - The Future That Both of Them Draw in the Sky

name: Food Exposed with Nelufar Hedayat
summary: Food Exposed with Nelufar Hedayat will cover topics such as fish, dairy, water, GMOs, superfoods, palm oil, and pork. Hosted by award-winning journalist Nelufar Hedayat, the eye-opening series examines how our appetites shape our world, investigating the global food chain and the origins of our favorite ingredients. As she travels the world, Nelufar reveals the true cost of food to people, animals, and the planet. This ambitious, sometimes shocking and revelatory series spans the globe from the North Pole to China, the oceans of West Africa to the forests of Asia and explores the future of food and how we're going to feed our rapidly-expanding population.

name: Mellan Raderna
summary: Anders Jansson loves English football. Therefore, "Between the Rows" is his dream program. And if you love English football as much as Jansson, you should definitely not miss this magazine. The perfect blend of laughter and football nerd.

name: Sveriges bästa
summary: Nostalgia, many laughs, emotional reunions, exclusive music performances and heavy revelations about the milestones in our Swedish entertainment and sports history. In each program, Gry Forssell handles a new leaderboard category, and the winning contributions are presented in various sections from spot ten to spot one.

name: Ликвидация
summary: The year is 1946. World War II is over, but it doesn't mean that there is no one to fight with. The post-war city of Odessa is ruled by serial killer prison-escapees and former Nazi collaborators. Fallen into disfavor, Marshal Zhoukov is sent to Odessa by Joseph Stalin to handle the situation. Together with the head of the local criminal investigation unit, David Gottsman, Zhoukov begins a special operation cleanup post-war Odessa from crime.

name: The Serpent
summary:
Con man, escape artist, thief, master of disguise and psychopath, Charles Sobhraj was the chief suspect in the sensational unsolved murders of up to 20 young Western travellers across India, Thailand and Nepal through 1975 and 1976. Having slipped repeatedly from the grasp of authorities worldwide, by 1976 Sobhraj was Interpol's most wanted man and had arrest warrants on three different continents.

When Herman Knippenberg, a junior diplomat at the Dutch Embassy in Bangkok, unwittingly walks into Sobhraj's intricate web of crime, he sets off an extraordinary chain of events that will see these two diametrically opposed men engaged in a chase across the porous borders of the Asian Hippie Trail in its twilight years.

The Serpent is based on the phenomenal true story of how one of the most elusive criminals of the 20th century was caught and brought to trial.

name: Luke Nguyen's Food Trail
summary: Luke Nguyen is back in a brand-new 13-part series! This time he traces his life and career from where it all started in Sydney, moving to Saigon and then onto Hong Kong.

name: Prehistoric: Predators of the Past
summary: Sorry, Jurassic Park, but T. rexes and Velociraptors weren't the only meat-eating monsters on the prehistoric horizon. Three Discovery Channel programs bring you up close to some of the fastest, fiercest, and hungriest denizens of the ancient land, seas, and skies. Included are "What Killed the Mega-Beasts?," "Rise of the Feathered Dragon," and the "Prehistoric Assassins" episode "Blood in the Water".

name: Great Gear
summary: Great Gear brings you the latest products born from unique Japanese ideas and technologies.

name: Ни слова о любви
summary: Cyril, Misha and Anton are friends from school. Once they dreamed of becoming travelers and the three of them traveling the whole world, but life was ordered differently. The good-natured hefty Misha graduated from the medical institute and became one of the best pediatricians of the city, Anton turned out to be a boring computer genius with a tattered beard and a lot of bad habits, while Cyril now works as the editor-in-chief of the glossy men's magazine. Companions of life in our heroes are absent for various reasons. But fate decides to test the strength and friendship of the heroes, and their attitudes. Misha once invited to participate in the morning telecast - and in the person of the host Sony, he unexpectedly meets his second half. Misha does not dare to introduce his friends to his chosen one, which causes Sonya to be suspicious. Suffering in silence is not Sunny's style, so one day she arranges a surprise for Misha and his friends, unexpectedly appearing at their meeting.

name: The Fashion Hero
summary: The Fashion Hero is a global movement celebrating diversity and overturning the perception of beauty. It's a modeling talent show, but it's not about the looks: We want the models to be role-models for a new generation. These unlikely models will compete in a series of challenges while tackling physical and emotional struggles, proving that unconventional beauty can become the new norm.

name: Mike & Angelo
summary: A boy called Mike discovers Angelo, a mysterious humanoid from 'another dimension, a different universe beyond infinity' who lives in his wardrobe and turns everyone's life upside-down by performing all kinds of magical tricks.

name: Selwyn
summary: Following on from the successful series, Oh No It's Selwyn Froggit, Selwyn has uprooted himself from Scarsdale to the Paradise Valley Holiday Camp, where he has been appointed as the Entertainments Officer.

name: Nomad of Nowhere
summary: A mysterious nomad traverses a western wasteland-but a price on his head sends him on the run from captors and bounty hunters, who all want to score big when they bring in the world's last magical being.

name: Reality Obsessed
summary: Each episode of Reality Obsessed has Murtz Jaffer on the hunt for answers to a particular ‘big picture' question in the realm of reality television. He'll explore how reality cameras affect the outcome of a complete geek hooking up with a hot babe; how casting directors find the perfect mix of angels and monsters for the next big hit, or what happens after contestants' 15 minutes of fame are up? It's a full blown celebration of everything reality!

name: Elvis Presley: The Searcher
summary:
He was a boy from Tupelo who grew up to become the biggest star in music. Along the way, he absorbed a staggering range of influences, creating a revolutionary sound in his lifelong search for self-expression.

Following his creative journey from childhood through the final 1976 Jungle Room recording sessions, two-part presentation Elvis Presley: The Searcher includes stunning atmospheric shots taken inside Graceland, Elvis' iconic home, and features more than 20 new, primary source interviews with session players, producers, engineers, directors and other artists who knew him or who were profoundly influenced by him. It also features never-before-seen photos and footage from private collections worldwide, and an original score by Pearl Jam lead guitarist Mike McCready.

name: Tandem
summary: Commander Léa Soler and Captain Paul Marchal are divorced, but they'll have to team up. Not to mention their teenage children, Alice and Thomas, who are also forced to see each other outside of work.

name: Innocent Days
summary: Sasaki Shinichi watches his childhood friend Tanaka Yukino receive the death sentence in court. She had set the apartment of the man whom she had dated on fire, and caused his wife and child to be burned to death. Shinichi's intuition tells him that Yukino is not the real criminal. Wanting to save Yukino, he goes to meet the different people who know her, but hears about her bitter past wherever he goes. Meanwhile, Yukino waits dispassionately for the time of her death sentence which is drawing near. Prison guard Sadoyama Hitomi begins to be drawn to her for some reason...

name: Missions of Love
summary: Yukina Himuro is a junior high student without any experience in love. She also secretly writes cell phone novels under a pen name. Yukina Himuro receives feedback from her readers that her stories lack romance. One day, she happens to read a notebook that belongs to Shigure Kitami. He is popular with girls at her school and he carries himself as a well-mannered guy. Yukina Himuro discovers his secret in his notebook.She decides to take advantage of her discovery and gain material for her novel. She blackmails Shigure Kitami and gives him missions of love to perform.
